thread:
Rao: quick postmortem follow-up: we need a compact action list for alert tuning across infra and services. Focus: reduce paging for noisy transients, tighten thresholds where safe, and add a short dedupe policy for flapping metrics.

Leah: I'll take infra-msq alerts (msq-queue-*) 1. Plan: widen threshold for queue-latency from 95th 200ms -> 300ms during deploy windows, add a 2m suppression for consecutive bursts. Will run a canary on Wednesday.

Tom: I'll own dedupe policy. Proposal: default dedupe 7m for metric flaps, but add a fast-escalation rule: if suppressed events >=3 within 45m, force a page. Implementation note: need to update alert-manager config and exporter.

Priya: I'll update runbooks and the paging doc. Suggest we formalize "deploy windows" tag so we don't suppress customer-facing alerts during deploys by mistake. Also add a post-rollout verification checklist.

Rao: good. Can we make the verification checklist explicit here so we can copy into tasks? minimal items: 1) canary spike run results + dashboard links; 2) check pages count vs baseline; 3) confirm no increase in customer errors.

Leah: will paste canary logs and dashboards. Quick smoke command I plan to use:

```
# staging spike: burst 200 reqs at P50
seq 1 200 | xargs -n1 -P40 curl -fsS https://staging/msq/health || echo spike
```

oncall-bot: created task INFR-2701 "MSQ alert tuning: threshold + suppression" assigned to Leah, due 2026-04-07.

Tom: note: exporter versions <1.3 drop dedupe metadata. I'll gate dedupe rollout on alert-exporter v1.3 being deployed to staging. I'll add a small test that simulates 5 short gaps.

Priya: timeline: runbook PR Tue, canary Wed, prod roll Fri with 72h monitoring window. Paging policy update PR Wed as well.

Rao: owners/timeline summary: Leah (msq thresholds & canary) due 2026-04-07; Tom (dedupe policy & exporter compatibility) will land staging tests Thu; Priya (runbook & paging doc) PR Tue. Add verification note to task before close.

pagerduty-bot: FYI: paging policy change requires PD escalation matrix update.

Leah: acknowledged. I'll coordinate with SRE on PD changes.

Tom: one more safeguard: if suppression hides >1 true positive in 24h, auto-revert suppression and notify oncall.

Rao: agreed. Closing loop: I'll ping PM and support with the list of alerts we plan to change. Tagging @incident-review for visibility. Thanks all.
